x: Paul Nihill of Surrey went away from the start but at 3 miles Ronny Wallwork overtook him and shortly afterwards the Surrey man was pulled. Further back Ray Middleton and Bob Barnes were moving through steadily after a cautious start with Eric and Ray Hall well placed not far behind.
Ray middleton walked a great race to take third place, just over a minute behind a stylish Arthur Jones who was himself only 40 seconds from the winner Ronny Wallwork.
September 14th - Morecambe Open 20 Kilos. In his best race ever Carl Lawton powered past none other the Ronny Wallwork to record 99.02 for a slightly short 20.
